title: world.index.offer
description: A region's WorldIndex as the server publishes it, by content hash and wire size only (MG9 G2G, GEN2_BRIDGE_PLAN.md §8): on join after world.regions (a legacy world: first) and whenever a build publishes. The client takes it from its own cache by hash, or asks for it with world.index.get; the world.index parts that answer carry it deflated.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the WorldIndex's UTF-8 JSON text (what the region's shape map names).

chars.description: Its wire form's length: the world.index parts' text, all together.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
